snippet: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis (ICI-AM) is rare but potentially fatal. We retrospectively reviewed pre-existing clinical records of 42 patients diagnosed with ICI-AM at Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University between October 2023 and March 2025 and classified them as mild (grade 1-2,= 29) or severe (grade 3-4,= 13).
